messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for 2027–2028
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. Our orders with you for part:340010 rose from EUR 28.94 (po:4500010364-10) to EUR 29.89 (po:4500010407-10) between 2023-12-27 and 2024-01-05. That rise is already in our price. Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010), below your price. The forecast for part:340010 increased by 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Your letter says you prioritise firm, long-term commitments. The attached term sheets offer exactly that: 23400 pieces per year, binding for 24 or 36 months. This secures your capacity planning and fills your lines with dependable volume. What is the earliest lead time you can confirm on these terms?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm long-term commitment for 2027–2028
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Furthermore, we have reviewed your data regarding price history and should-cost estimates. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We propose EUR 31.50 per unit for 23,400 pieces over 24 months, provided the lead time is 56 days. Our offer remains a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Which volume can you commit to?

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: part:340010 – firm 24-month commitment, revised term sheets
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised offer. To answer your question on volume: we commit to 23400 pieces per year, binding for 24 months.

Your letter of 18 September (doc:20260918-70410-P10) says you prioritise firm, long-term commitments. This package gives you that certainty for your capacity planning. We have moved our price on both attached term sheets.

The first sheet keeps our 42-day lead time. The second accepts your 56-day lead time. If the price step needs your pricing committee's approval, could you put the package to it at its next session?

What is the earliest lead time you can confirm for the first call-offs in January 2027?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: part:340010 – firm 24-month commitment, revised term sheets
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your commitment to 23,400 pieces over 24 months and revise our price to EUR 31.40. 

For your planning, our offer consists of a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days, and the earliest lead time we can confirm for January 2027 remains 56 days.

Please provide the exact data supporting your assertions. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
